instruction: A cinematic still photograph in a medium close-up shot at eye-level, set indoors with a background of wood paneling and grey marble. On the left, in the foreground, the woman in the light blue button-up shirt (R1) stands in profile, facing right with her hair tied back, looking off-camera to the right with a serious, contemplative expression. On the right, in the background, the woman in the grey long-sleeve shirt (R2) stands facing forward, looking directly at the camera with a steady, neutral expression. The woman in the grey shirt (R2) stands close behind the woman in the light blue shirt (R1), resting her right hand gently on her left shoulder. Soft, natural indoor lighting coming from the front-left creates gentle shadows on their faces and highlights the textures of their clothing.
